thread:
aj: taking over oncall for the next 8h. quick heads-up: i'm going to add a temporary routing filter to push noisy gpu_batch_latency alerts to #eng-runtime for ~2h while we patch the batching config. leaving a rollback window and smoke test instructions.

maria: thanks — will this suppress pages or just re-route?

aj: re-route only, not suppress. rule: if alert.rule == "gpu_batch_latency" AND service == "batch" -> route: eng-runtime. also bumping threshold from 2s -> 5s for the duration. plan to revert at ~2h or earlier if anything odd.

kevin: can you paste the CLI you used so I can reproduce if needed? i'll keep an eye on pager.

aj: sure — applied with cli:
```
# temp route change
./alertctl update-policy --name gpu_batch_latency --route eng-runtime --threshold 5s --duration 2h --meta note="temp route for patch"
```

sam: noted. i'll leave infra leads on rotation and watch for downstream errors. @kevin are you ok to monitor for missed user-impact alerts?

kevin: yep i'll watch dashboards and logs. if we see user-facing latency spike we'll revert immediately.

oncall-bot: POLICY_UPDATE: gpu_batch_latency routed to eng-runtime by aj at 1978503225. expires in 2h.

maria: i'll run the smoke after it's applied: `make smoke-batch` then check sample traces.

aj: change applied at 1978503225. leaving an explicit rollback scheduled at 197850= to avoid forgetting (i'll also add a calendar reminder). pls ack if you're good with this window. :wave:

kevin: ack :thumbsup: i'll monitor for false-negatives.

sam: ack, watching logs :eyes:

maria: ack, smoke in progress — will post results in 5m.

aj: putting a short note in the handoff doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/oncall/temp-route-1978503210 — includes CLI, rationale, how to revert.

kevin: if anything escalates, ping #pager-escalations and loop me in.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: temporary policy expires in ~2h (automated).

maria: smoke passed — no trace errors in the sample. reverting plan stands.

aj: thanks all, i'll handoff at the usual swap. leaving this thread open until policy expires.
